title: derivative-free parametric optimizer over any receipted analyzer (Nelder-Mead + deterministic multi-start)

governing_equations.name: scalarized cost
governing_equations.expr: min_x  sum_i s_i w_i f_i(x) + sum_t w_t ((g_t(x) - v_t)/tol_t)^2 + 10 (1+|obj|) sum_c viol_c(x)
governing_equations.description: Objectives (sign s_i = -1 when maximized), quadratic convergence targets, and objective-relative constraint penalties, minimized by Nelder-Mead simplex over the box-bounded parameters. A weighted sum is NOT a Pareto front — each term is reported separately in the receipt.

governing_equations.name: relative constraint penalty
governing_equations.expr: viol = v/max - 1 (above a max) | min/v - 1 (below a min)
governing_equations.description: Dimensionless relative violation, scaled by 10*(1+|objective|) so a 10% violation dominates any objective magnitude. Selection is FEASIBILITY-FIRST: the reported best is the best candidate with zero violations whenever one was seen (ulp-scale violations cannot win by float rounding).

governing_equations.name: robust (worst-case) aggregation
governing_equations.expr: score(x) = max over tolerance corners c of score(x + c)
governing_equations.description: With robust.tols set, every candidate is also evaluated at the tolerance extremes (full 2^k corners for k<=3, else 2k axis extremes — the scheme is stated in the receipt) and scored on the worst case; constraints must hold at every corner.

assumptions: Continuous parameters in finite [min, max] boxes; candidates are clamped, never rejected, at the bounds.
The evaluator is a pure function of the parameters (same inputs => same receipt); nondeterministic analyzers break the determinism guarantee and can mislead the simplex.
Single scalarization per run — trade-off exploration needs multiple runs with different weights (reported per-term so the trade-off stays visible).
Derivative-free local search: multi-start (deterministic bit-reversed lattice) mitigates but does not eliminate local minima; no global-optimality claim is made.
Engine-evaluator objectives read the kernel's validated measures; command-evaluator objectives are only as trustworthy as the analyzer behind them (see its own manifest/tier).

boundary_conditions.fixtures: not applicable — parameter-space search; the physics boundary conditions live in the evaluated program/analyzer job.
boundary_conditions.selector_count_unit: evaluations (each eval is one full analyzer run)

inputs.params: user-defined (mm, Hz, ... — whatever the template consumes)
inputs.targets.value/tol: same unit as the target expression
inputs.constraints.min/max: same unit as the constraint expression

outputs.best_objective: unit of the legacy objective expression

discretization.element: Nelder-Mead simplex (scipy), xatol 1e-3, fatol 1e-9; coordinate-sweep fallback without scipy
discretization.notes: Deterministic: no RNG, no clocks; multi-start points come from a bit-reversed lattice, so receipts are byte-identical across runs (R5).

validation.ground_truth: Analytic known-optimum problems via a hermetic command evaluator: argmin of (x-3)^2+(y+1)^2 = (3,-1); the real root of x^3+13x = 40 (x* = 2.0912942); maximize x s.t. x <= 7 has optimum exactly at the cap.
validation.direction: no systematic bias — direct search on the analyzer's own receipts; the pin also asserts byte-identical receipts across reruns (determinism).

caveats: Legacy contract: a bare 'objective' MAXIMIZES by default; pass maximize:false to minimize (pinned so it cannot silently flip).
Local optimizer: a multi-modal objective can converge to a local optimum; raise multi_start and inspect per-start bests in the receipt.
constraint_ok:false means the search never found a feasible candidate — the reported best is then the least-bad infeasible point, said loudly in the receipt.
Witness-edge drift across the sweep makes objectives non-comparable; drifted candidates are rejected and the run is stamped selection_unstable (see receipt selection_evidence).

limits_of_validity.regime: smooth-ish objectives over <= ~8 continuous parameters; discrete/categorical choices are out of scope
limits_of_validity.resolution: budget-bounded: max_evals caps total analyzer runs (split across starts); robust mode multiplies each eval by the corner count
